description: The grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" across four linguistic "tag" categories for six different model configurations. The horizontal axis, labeled "tag", displays the categories in the following order from left to right: case, gender, number, and tense. The vertical axis, labeled "effect", uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 5, and features horizontal grid lines extending across the chart area. Within each tag category, the bars are grouped into sets of six, representing different models as indicated by the legend. From left to right within each group, the bars are colored light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, light pink for mBERT-B₂, and dark red for XLM-B₂. The highest values are observed in the "case" category, where the mBERT-B₂ bar is the tallest at approximately 12.5, followed closely by XLM-B₂ at roughly 11.5. The lowest values are found in the "tense" category, where all bars are near zero, with the mBERT-R₂ bar dipping slightly below zero to approximately -0.1. Across all categories, the mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ models generally exhibit the highest effect values within their respective groups. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted alphabetically or by a strict value trend, though overall effect values generally decrease from left to right across the chart. All bars feature a thin black outline and are annotated with black error bars extending above and below the top edge of each bar, with the largest error bars appearing in the "case" category.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations on various linguistic tags, categorized into case, gender, number, and tense. The horizontal axis represents the tag categories, labeled 'tag,' and includes case, gender, number, and tense. The vertical axis is labeled 'effect,' ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5 units. Each tag category features grouped bars representing different models or conditions, distinguished by specific colors corresponding to the legend: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, pink for mBERT-B₂, and red for XLM-B₂. In the 'case' category, mBERT-L₂ consistently exhibits the highest effect, with values exceeding 15, while XLM-B₂ shows the lowest effect, remaining below 5. The 'tense' category demonstrates a steady decline across all models, with values approaching zero. Error bars indicate the standard deviation, with the largest variability observed in the 'gender' category across all models.
